lessons.content:
Building Tip Videos — Coming Soon! 🔧

Our mechanics team is putting together short, practical videos of tips we've learned from building competition robots — things like bracing, spacing, gear meshing, cutting clean C-channel, and wiring tidily.

Check back here soon. In the meantime, if you're stuck on a build, grab a mechanics lead and ask — that's the fastest way to learn.
